body: We set off at 6.30am at Mirissa Harbour. The sea looked relatively calm but I took the precaution of taking a travel sickness pill at 6am. They were offering these on board too. So glad I did and I was fine but others who hadn't were being sick and it ruined their experience - there was quite a big swell on the open sea. We started to see whales after about an hour and we saw several over the 4 hours we were at sea. There were other boats present but I felt they were all pretty respectful with their distance. The guy on our boat took video footage for us so we were able to concentrate on looking at the whales without our phones interfering! They staff were very friendly and jokey and made us feel welcome. They also gave us a plate of food and coffee, which was nice! A thoroughly enjoyable experience!
title: Great Whale Watching Experience!

body: A suggestion by our guide while staying in Galle was to try Whale Watching. We left him organise the details as there are so many companies offering this it is hard to choose.Well now after doing it, I would recommend no one else but the Whale Warriors. From the beginning, before we left dock we got a wonderfully informative talk (not long thought) about whales, what we might see and a reminder that these are wild mammals so don’t adhere to timetables or showtimes. As we set out we were treated to coffee (or tea), a plated cold breakfast with fruit, cake, a sandwich and pork sausage. Amazing considering the goal is to see whales but the crew we’re making sure that we were catered for. On the way back there was fresh juice, pineapple and a wet cloth to freshen up with. This alone was a wonderful experience to have at sea. For the whale watching, we we arrived out to the general area there was over 20 boats ranging in size and a plane flying over. When a whale appeared, motors thundered, boats flew over the waves, rushing to the location for a picture. Therefore the whales didn’t surface too much. I wouldn’t surface to that commotion either. But our crew kept us informed and told us to be patient. They are skilled and know what they are doing.After an hour to two hours most of the boats left. People/groups doing other tours...etc. This is what our crew wanted. Now the waters were quieter and we had an idea of the whales travelling area we were treated to the whales surfacing over and over again. It was amazing and shows the skill of our crew to aid us in seeing these majestic mammals. The crew helped people with photos, taking phones to get better angles and ensuring we were all having a great time. By the end they we’re making sure if we wanted to see one more which were all erupted with YES. The crew couldn’t have done more. Thank You Duminda for having a great team on board!!We we got back to hotel later (only 12pm so was very reasonable time) the staff were amazed by the amount of photos we got as many people miss out on the whales due to the number of boats out in the water. But thanks to Miriama Whale Warriors, not us!!

body: Just as a background i dint know about Whale watching in Sir Lanka, this trip was completely planned by my wife. It was a pleasant surprise for me to see whale watching in her itinerary. Its been a dream to watch whales swim across the ocean. Its kind of poetic to see them majestically swim across. Now coming back to the review of Mirissa Whale Warriors. I did a tour with them on 24th Jan 19, we had to reach the boat around 6 am, although the boat doesn’t leave till about 7 am, the best seats get taken first so its advisable to reach early and pick a seat. First impressions were the boat was nice and clean with life vest kept for all seats. The crew was very warm and inviting. They offer a nice breakfast on the boat so you don’t really need to worry about carrying a box from your hotel. The food they served was really good quality. They served some amazing sausage. Crew even offered sea sickness pills just in case anyone needed them. Our host and captain of the boat spoke about the sea we were to visit a brief on the whales. Since they dont use technology to track the whales it does take time to spot them, different boats coordinate with each other over the phone. It took us nearly 3 hours to reach a lone whale, the experience of watching it was truly magical, our captain was quite good at following the mammal around and anticipating its next move, at a couple of occasions we had the whale right next to our boat. It left us in Awe. They crew was really sweet to take videos for us and letting us spend more time watching the whale, we were the last boat to leave the site. This will truly be one of the most wonderful experiences of my life
title: Whale watching

body: I think the best way to go through this review is give you a short description then a run through of the day.Boat is a smaller one of the fleet which goes out daily in search of whales, which is great, no over crowding, excellent service and plenty of space.In between this run down remember to keep your eye on the ocean to see if you can pick up any animals! 7-00am set sail: Lovely day, blue skies, equally blue water and relatively calm seas.7-10am short intro: This locally run business owner gives a short overview of the business and the whales and dolphins you have a chance to see that day, but please remember there is never a guarantee! 7-30am breakfast: delicious breakfast served just after coffee, sandwich, fruit, cake and pancakes. 8-30am fruit: Some fruit is delivered pineapple and water melon!9-00am onwards, a number of hours will be spent in search of animals, no sonar or radars are used as this can be harmful to animals. All experience and knowledge of the ocean. Placed in the middle of the ocean no view of land are around 10 boats, this increases the chances of a sighting, as if one boat sees something, it contacts all. We managed to find our self a blue whale which stayed with us for close to an hour, multiple sightings, one of which was about 3m from the boat! Once the guest have each gotten the opportunity to enjoy the whale and take photos etc, the return trip begins. Sadly on this day we did not see anything other than a single blue whale, but thats all down to chance, no dolphins etc, or other whale breeds. But I know much of this is luck. Still a great day!On the return journey fresh fruit juice and other snacks are served. And a cold towel shortly before entering port. The staff are great the boat is great! Strongly recommend. Only reason for not 5 star, is the lack of other marine life and perhaps the seats aren't quite as comfortable as they could be on the lower deck. Enjoy your trip, I would not pick another whale watching service provider, ex-fisherman for generations to whale watcher, who could perform this better?
title: Blue Whale Sighting

body: We left port about 7 easy steam out to where whales were feeding I'd imagine Sore some dolphins on the way out then headed out for the whales not disappointed lots whales good captain wasn't over crowding so you seem to get whale longer on the surface good picks and we were lucky sea pretty flat nice and sunny all good breakfast fruit juice fruit I enjoyed it 👍😄

body: I enjoyed my whale watching trip with Mirissa Whale Warriors immensely. The boat set off nice and early to give us maximum time on the water. The boat was a nice size, large enough to feel secure but not too big or full, so there was plenty of space.A nice breakfast was included in the cost of the ticket, along with tea, coffee and water. We were given a great introduction to the trip, very informative but not overwhelming. We were very lucky to see 2 turtles embracing, and three whales by 10am! There were about 6 other boats out on the water at the same time which killed the magic a little, but our guide did his best to show us as much as possible.We were given delicious fruit mid-morning, along with an amazing passionfruit drink. These were served in plastic cups with plastic straws - it would be great if the juice was in a reusable cup instead. But still, delicious. And a nice cold wet towel with essential oils ended the trip. Very pleasant, very thoughtful, a nice touch.I would definitely recommend this trip.

title: Memorable day out

body: Had the good fortune and luck of going whale watching with Duminda and the Whale warriors team. My AIRBNB Host suggested me this company and initially i thought it was a mistake as our boat was one of the last ones to leave thanks to a delayed group of chinese tourist who were booked on with us but once we started we had the best and closest sightings from all the boats cumulatively put together and that was all thanks to the captain who also owns the boat.Duminda, Hes relatively new to the Whale watching business but hes an old player at sea. He was a fisherman for 19 years and has sailed to far corners of the world (Australia and Oman) on fishing expeditions lasting months. Once he his team ventured into indian waters and were briefly detained.He exactly knows the behaviour of the whales, tracking is done without any devices and his boat is not packed with tourist unlike some other companies whose boats looked like they would topple, packed to the brim.We spotted some 8-9 whales and everytime our boat would be headed in a different direction from where the other boats would be going. The whales surface 3-4 times to fill in their lungs and then dive for periods of 30-40 mins.He kept the boat parallel to the whale and slightly behind its line of sight which was a science and secret logic no other boats were follow resulting in our boat having the closest and longest sightings of the mammoth creature. We even could experience whales flanking (raising their tail while diving) more than a couple of times at a distance of nothing more than 30 feet.He speaks broken english but was able to successfully communicate with me and convey all the points im covering in my review. I am able to write this review because im quite passionate about wildlife and marine life hence i took the opportunity to chat up with him. Duminda is passionate about what hes doing and does a lot for the conservation of whales since that Sea corridor is a busy one and sees approximately 300 ships passing daily.The waters are ideal for whales to feed and come give birth as a lot of rivers flow into the waters off mirissa bringing in shrimp, the water is warm and ideal for the whales.All in all, Sri Lanka is a beautiful country with a near proximity from India, i will definitely visit again and go whale watching with none else but these guys for the personalized and warm hospitality they gave and of course the best sightings.
title: An awesome sighting of the Blue Whale

body: Whole team was very friendly and supportive. We had wonderful experience . Watched two type whales. Duminda has vast experience and knowledge about their habitat. Will recommend him. His patience and concern not to disturb their habitat to be appreciated. Thank you Duminda and your team. Good going
title: Awesome and friendly Warrior tram

body: The captain Duminda is very enthusiastic in sharing his days as a fisherman to where he is now - a whale "spotter" (: Ask him any questions about the sea and he will be glad to answer.There are many creatures in the sea, but besides the blue whales and dolphins that are tolerant of humans, the orcas, humpbacks etc shy away from us, so don't get too bummed out if you don't spot anything else.We spotted at least 30+ dolphins and probably 5 blue whales. It was an exciting sight to see many pods of dolphins frolicking in the water and swimming really close to our boat! The whole trip lasts for about 4 hours. Be prepared for a long, puke-inducing ride. On the day we went, the currents were rather strong and three quarter of the people on board actually puked. I wish they warned us ahead though.We had about 20ish people and everyone could get a good view of the marine animals. Fruits and tea were offered and the crew took good care of the sick passengers. No comments on the breakfast provided as I had my own.Overall, it was an enjoyable trip with many photos taken.
title: Blue whales and dolphins!

body: When you arrive at the boat yard it is a free for all with lots of vendors all at the same spot each working for different companies wanting to take your money. We had a tuk tuk pick us up from our homestay as we were told this was a must to find the yard but from the main bus stop it’s like 5/10mins walk, very close so no real need for added tuk tuk cost. From what I could see all the rates seemed to be the same and flat at 6000rupee each. For the price of the tour breakfast was disappointing. Everything cold, two triangle sandwiches, sweet rolled pancake and two small bananas with a Luke warm tea. When you pay almost £30 each it would have been nicer to have better selection and better taste.Duminda is a nice bloke and has spent a lot of time perfecting his English at English school for the sake of tourism. He is very chatty and likes to explain a lot of things which is nice. He has a long past spent as a fisherman and has hunted a lot of fish in the past, spending many days at sea. I spoke with him a lot during our trip as the whole thing lasted almost 8 hours (so be ready for a (too) long trip home after you spot a whale). I would like to think that he has changed his outlook on fishing now and wants to look more at preservation as opposed to hunting/fishing. I must be completely honest though, I feel he may have made the jump from fisherman to whale watching host due to ever depleting fishing reserves and the fact that more money can be made through tourism and also more time with his family. I prefer to believe that he has done it due to preferring to conserve wildlife now over money $$$.On the trip out we saw a school of dolphins which was very pleasant. Then the other boats start congregating and it descends in to pure chaos!From then on it around 18 boats total were in close pursuit of whales an anything that swam with a pulse! It was horrific! Gallons of diesel is dumped in to the ocean as all the boats blast off and scare the whale as best they can!Dumina was passionate about other boats hounding the whales and insisted he has a more fair outlook on whale spotting and does not like this behaviour, but in the mean time he has to please his guests. Thankfully he was more reserved in his approach with the throttle and speed to the one whale we kept seeing, but it was still distressing.He was telling me that holiday boats from around hear things on the radios and also just randomly follow whale spotting boats in the bid to blankly see something.Some boats have as many as 100 people on board. Thankfully ours was limited to around 25.The trip was very drawn out all in all, we left our hostel at 6am and returned to our accommodation at 3pm, so get ready for a snooze on the way back as once you spot a whale the crew are keen to get back (and their isn't a great deal to see at all on the way back).We saw a turtle on the way back which was cool also and they provide you with some fruit and fruit juices also which is a great touch and greatly appreciated. Having done the trip it left us in a very funny frame of mind, feeling guilty in playing a part in this animal cruelty! I'm not sure I would recommend as a result!Lots more really needs to be done in Marissa to police this spotting, it's tragic! I'm not sure those involved are doing enough to be completely honest! I kind of feel they are just taking the money in the meantime and just complaining about others and their ethics (lack of).Beware....
title: More needs to be done to save and preserve whales!!!

body: The boat owner and captain, Duminda is an experienced former local fisherman who is a great environmentalist and very knowledgeable about whales in the Mirissa area. He kept the boat a good distance from the whales and he had an excellent instinct for where the whales should be. We had several sightings of Blue Whales and also a Bryde's Whale mother and calf. During the trip we were served with welcome drinks and fresh fruit. Thoroughly recommended.
title: Whale Watching Highlight

body: Duminda and his crew were very professional. We had multiple sightings of blue whales, and unlike all the other boats, Duminda’s crew kept more of a distance from the animals whilst still allowing us to see them. Tri-shaws came to collect us from the hotel, so that made it easy. Small thing: Breakfast was offered to some passengers but not all. We noticed people who came before and after us, but aside from coffee/tea, I think we got skipped. Fresh fruit and juice offered to everyone later was a nice touch.To those considering going, when the crew offers to take photos for you and you accept (it is really helpful when the boat is heaving), you really should leave a tip for them. There’s a tip jar as you exit the boat. Their efforts are worth the 500 rupees/$3.32 usd.
title: A Wonderful Experience

body: This small boat cruise was a great experience for whale watching. We were given some information about the whales and besides the highlight of spotting and observing the behaviour of whales and frolicking dolphins, it was eagle eyed crew - not only pointing to the sea animals but also caring for the passengers.Good breakfast is provided - but if you are prone to sea sickness - avoid it and the experience of whale watching will be excellent.
title: Caring crew and great at spotting whales and dolphins

body: Captain knows a lot about whales and will tell you about them. He can really accurately predict where the whale will show up. We saw a blue whale really close to our boat in few occasions. Same was with the dolphins.Crew is very helpful and they will serve you with coffee/tea, breakfast, fresh fruit, juice and refreshing towels.First class service.
title: They know what they do!

body: Of the many compagnies in Mirissa offering the whalewatching tours i was lucky enough just to pick the right one. The crew of Mirissa Whale Warriors is doing an excellent job. They offer a smallscaled ship, comes with a good breakfast and other extras like fruitsnacks, waterbottle, juice, and even a cleaning towel. What is more important is that this crew has a different approach compared with some other compagnies and their ships who seem to chase the whales. These guys have eagle eyes and know how to spot a whale and in my tour it seemed every time they had the best encounter with a whale while not scaring it. We had very close vision on the whale for a view times. Same with the dolphins. The captain managed to have the dolphins swimming along and jumping in front of the ship while the other boats already seemd to have left for the harbour. Everything with respect for the animals and so well taken care of. In my opinion i was on the best ship.It might be a bit of a challenge to find the bookingoffice to book the whale warriors. I did it on Beach road of Marissa, opposit the flora and fauna hostel. There is a marketstablestyle clothingshop where you can book these tours. Right next to the beachacces path. There is a billboard outside. The young man running this shop can book you on the tour and makes sure the tuctuc is picking you up at your hotel at the exact giving time. Do not look any further. There was really nothing to complain about anything on this tour.
title: Excellent whalewatching tour in Mirissa

body: "The whale warriors" they are one of the best in this field. The knowledge of Duminda about the sea and Marine life is very good. The staff are friendly and food superb. I went with them more than 10 times, every single time warriors were successful to show us a blue 🐋. I have tried some of the others but he is the best by far for me and for my whale watching clients. I can recommend Duminda for anyone to get this lifetime experience of whale watching.
title: Mirrissa whale warriors

body: We loved our boat trip with Duminda. He is always willing to show his love for the sea, and he is also very respectful of the whales (contrary to some other boats which where around us on the sea...). We saw whales, and so many dolphins all around the boat! We were also given tea, breakfast, water, fruits, juice... and even a wet towel at the end to refresh your face. We really recommend Whale Warriors :)
title: Serious and respectful whales watching company

body: Duminda was the best captain and guide we could have. We appreciated the smaller boat, which was not so crowded. We also liked the gentle approach of the captain to the whales, not like the other ships that aggressively chased them. We were guaranteed to see whales and a 50% chance of seeing dolphins. Since Duminda was formerly a fisherman, he has plenty of friends at sea among fishermen who call him when they see dolphins. We had the luck that we could see a large pod of dolphins.Highly recommend!
title: Excellent!

body: Fantastic day out to see the blue whales coming underneath the boat very helpful staff the captains knowledge brought the whales right next to us once in a lifetime chance thanks
title: Excellent day out

body: We really recommend this whale watching tour - the captain and the crew where really respecting the animals of the sea but still made sure we saw whales (close up). Seems to know what they do and took the extra time to make sure we had a good experience.
title: Recommended!

body: All tours charge the same unless you are in a group, the difference between them is the crew. I recommend the crew of Whale warriors they were fab at spotting whales, their english was great and their knowledge of the ocean was awesome. Highly recommend!
title: Highly Recommend!

body: Duminda and his crew did excellent job, crew is super helpful and caring, Duminda has creat experience and knowledge of whales and shares that with creat passion. He is also very keen on rules and not disturbing the animals.Our boat was the last to leave, he did his best that everyone got nice view of the whale
title: Highly recommend

body: It was a major highlight going whale-watching; going out to sea was a little intense as the waters were rather rough but it is so worth it when we got to catch many glimpses of whales and even dolphins. The crew was dedicated to ensure we get to see whales and were just as excited as we were whenever there are sightings, also very happy to share their experiences and knowledge about the beautiful creatures. The entire experience was just brilliant!
title: Highly recommended!

body: The staff made all the efforts to show us whales, so in the end it took 6 hours. They provided breakfast, refreshments, fruits, hot and soft drinks. But an important notice: if you are not an experienced sailor you should consider taking anti-seasickness pills before the tour to avoid nausea (most of our fellow pessengers seemingly had it)!! The ocean is rough even in good weather conditions. But all in all it is unforgettable experience, especially with this crew!!!
title: It's must :)

body: Duminda and his crew made all the efforts to show us whales and dolphins yesterday in out off session. We started at about 7 in the morning and finished at 1 PM. Duminda and crew never give up their efforts to find the Fin whale the second biggest in indian ocean. They provided breakfast refreshments hot and soft drinks and knowledge about fishes and whales onboard
title: No whales without Duminda

body: we took a whale watching excursion with Mirissa Whale Warriors and am happy i made that deicison, the team is experienced knows exactly what they looking for and where tbey looking, we got to watch killer whales and blue whales up close and it was a great experince. anyone looking to do the same should go with them, best tour operators in Mirissa and very friendly.
title: Want watch whales go with Duminda

body: Our driver recommended Duminda, and it was the best advise he could have given us. Duminda and his crew were so great! They are respectfull of the whales, they don't get too closed and would never try you touch them. You can see Duminda is really passionate about them, he is a former fisherman so he definitely knows his way around this environment. His crew brings you a nice breakfast, tea, coffee (which can be a challenge with the waves). The size of the boat is perfect, approx. 35 seats, which gives you enough liberty to walk around and not be on top of each other, unlike other boats, you are not in a huge group. The price is very reasonnable, compared to other bigger boats. Overall this is an amazing experience, we will definitely cherish these memories. A must see in Mirissa!
title: Amazing experience with Duminda and his crew

body: We enjoyed a lot the experience. The day normally starts at 6am providing Tuk Tuk tansport from your hotel to the boat. The trip to the whales starts at 7am and normally finish at 11am. We were lucky and we could see the whales from really close perspective! Our impressions was that the tripulants knew very well how to find the whales, we were always the first boat to arrive to the spot. By the way the ticket includes also breackfast in the boat (sandwiches, water, juice and watermelon). A must experience nit only in mirissa but also in Sri Lanka!!
title: Amazing experience!!!

body: Great, friendly, and well experienced team. They fullfiled their promis to show us whales and dolphins. Also we would like to point out excelent services on the boat (incl. breakfast, refreshment cold towels etc.)
title: Excelent tour

body: We had a great time on the tour with Duminda and his crew - all of them were friendly and willing to help. Duminda shares some of his knowledge during the trip and is happy to answer any questions. We weren't sure whether we would actually see any whales to start with as we went off season but we did and we got so close!! I think that our boat had the best view of the whales so we were very pleased. Breakfast, drinks and fresh fruit are offered during the trip. I would definitely recommend this company - we had a great time!! Thank you Whale Warriors :)
title: Best whale watching tour

body: Very attractive trip. Also, hospitality is very high. Duminda have a lot of experience & knowledge in the sea & Whale. we saw the dolphin & whale.We highly recommend this company for your whale watching experience in Mirissa.cheers..
title: An incredible Whale Watching Tour.

body: We spent a very nice half day on this boat with Duminda and his staff, all of them very kind and helpfull. The trip to watch the whales and dolphins took around 4 hours, first we went to see some dolphins - we saw plenty of them what was very exciting. Then we searched for the whales and we found her/him pretty quickly. We saw the whale 4 times gettin up and down to the sea and the boat always kept distance from the whale and did not chase it, however you could still see the whale well. A nice service was provided on the trip - breakfast, plenty of water, fruit and juice on the way back along with the fresh wet towels.I really appreciate that the staff prepared a special breakfast for us, as we are staying at an ayurvedic center with some food limits - thank you very much guys.Morover - the price is only half of the rest boats have and you get a great time and service, so its definitely worth it. Recommending the Whale Warrios for your trip very much!
title: Very nice whale watching tour!

body: Duminda spent his childhood fishing in the area with his father and grand father. He knows the sea very well and is very respectful of the resident whales. He will take time to observe the animal behaviour to closely approach them, which is not the case with other boat companies that are rushing full blast once a whale appears. You will be delighted to have a nice breakfast with real plates and tea cups (no disposable plastics). Duminda has been fighting for Mirissa to be recognized as a marine protected area (MPA). If you do see freight cargos or oil drilling boats, please take pictures and report to WWF or Sea Shepherd.
title: Respecttful of the whales in their natural habitat

body: We had a perfect tour with this company, they have so much experience with the sea, the whales and nature. All the crew is very sweet and is trying to make a wonderfull day off it. They provide the best breakfast!! And a lot of water, juice and even a cold wet towel to cool down. The boat is like all the others, comfortable and clean. The captain is truelly amazing and very passionate about his work! I would definitly recommend this company. Thanks for the amazing day!!
title: So good!!

body: Mirissa whale warriors was a great company to use. We saw blue whales and also stopped to see dolphins on the way home. The company provided water, sea-sickness tablets, tea and coffee, breakfast snacks, juice and cold refreshing cloths at the end which was a nice touch. Very friendly and informed crew.
title: Great company to go with

body: We had a great time on this boat tour. The service was great; the captain was entertaining and wanted to make sure all the guests were happy. His colleagues, although didn't speak English (the captain did), were INCREDIBLY kind and hard working. One of them wanted to make sure we got a good video of the whales and when mine was wobbly, insisted he did the next viewing and got a perfect video for us. The captain knew exactly where the whales were and went out of his way on the way home to find some dolphins for us, while the other boats took the direct route home. Also, much better value than those who are number 1 and 2 on trip advisor and therefore charge double! We paid 3000 rupees, while the others were charging 6000!
title: Great service! AND CHEAPER THAN OTHERS

body: We really enjoyed our whale watching tour with "the Whale Warriors". We saw 5 blue whales and a lot of dolphins! What we especially like was that we were not that many people on the boat and that the boat was one of the smallest going out to the whales. This made it much more enjoyable since we saw boats with hundreds of people on it.
title: Nice tour!

body: I can't recommend these guys enough, they put on a brilliant tour which included way more than I realised. Tour includes:- approx 3.5 hour trip (you need to be on the boat around 6:15-6:30am).- A bottle of water before you set off- Breakfast - a pancake, cheese & cucumber sandwiches, a sausage & banana (a random mix but it was good)- A slice of fresh fruit - A fresh juice drink - Cold flannelsThe captain was brilliant and explained a bit about the whales and why they can be found in Sri Lanka. The captain asked me if I could help him and wanted to see if I was up for driving the boat...errrr yes! So I did so for about 20 mins! Amazing! We definitely got our quota of whale watching and saw at least 4 Blue whales and also 1 Bryde's whale. They were incredible to watch and you can spot them when they blow water from their blowholes. Our boat was very respectful of the whales and did not get too close or chase them down, they slowly followed them which was refreshing to see. We were also lucky enough to see 2 large turtles frolicking in the sea which was incredible. Definitely book your tour with these guys. They know what they are doing and are brilliant!
title: I saw Blue Whales & Bryde's Whales!!

body: We went on a trip with whale warriors and saw three whales and some dolphins. We also got some breakfast, water and a sirup drink on the way back which was gross. We were watching whales for about 45min before our boat went back to the harbour. Most boats stayed out longer and kept watching whales.. so no reason to leave early. Apparently the captain wanted to show us more dolphins which weren't there any more. Of course he wouldn't know after 19 years of fisherman experience and calling his friend who said they were gone by far. His English was okay but after mentioning my concerns on the short trip and high price (13 €/person) he suddenly didn't speak good English anymore. Summary: whale watching was very exciting but the price didn't fit what you got for it. I would choose someone else next time. Or pay no more than 5 €...
title: Whalewatching but short trip and no good customer service

body: I called too book with Geeth but got booked on this one instead. It's Geeths brother and I am really satisfied with it.Nice breakfast, super friendly crew and it seemed like they respected the whales. Snacks on the way back. And not a crowded boat like I saw some others.
title: Really good trip

body: If you are dreaming for whale watching, @Mirissa Whale Warriors with Duminda is the best sailing crew...Thanks you Duminda and Crew for everything you have done to make us happy and comfortable...Excellent...!!!
title: Simply Awesome

body: If you are dreaming get thrilling whale watching experience this is the best place you must go. how they serve during the safari was tremendous.You cannot expect more in this price range.Thank you Duminda & crew for everything.
title: Epic experien

body: Thanks for the brilliant opportunity for whale watching. I really love your service and it was amazing experience we ever had. I would recommend this place for everyone without any doubt . You need to definitely try this experience before try anywhere else.
title: Whale watching
Good organisation, not many whales
body: Whale warriors is very well organised. Good boat, good seats, lifevests for everyone. Nice breakfest. tea or coffe, bottle of water. Lateron fresh fruit and juice. The sighting itself is dissapointing, two hours sailing and two blue whales in the distance. On the way some Dolphins and three turtles.

title: Great trip!
body: If you want to go whale watching Mirissa, go with whale warriors! You will almost 100% see a whale/dolphins. The crew were super friendly, including the Captain - a former fisherman. The facilities were great and the food was lovely - we didn't eat much as we fell foul of sea sickness but it looked yummy and plentiful!! We did get a cup of tea straight away when we boarded which was very welcome, and the price included tuk tuk transfers to and from our accommodation.Other boats we passed did not look as comfy or as safe as ours hence why we would recommend Whale Warriors. However as a concept we weren't sure about Whale Watching, due to the nature of some of the other boats we worried whether the activity might be harmful to the ocean wildlife - hence we have only scored WW a 3. There are quite a few boats that tend to crowd the whales that surface and a lot have black tarry fumes belching out of them!! Overall these guys seem the best - if you want to whale watch do it with them.

title: great tour
body: our sri lankan driver arranged this early morning tour for us with Cpt Duminda. we saw turtles, pilot whales and blue whales. friendly crew, the captain knows a lot about whales (former fisherman). boat was comfortable with clean rest rooms and we were served excellent tea and fruits during the cruise.
